rules.title: League rules
rules.body: The full rule sheet lives with your league administrator. This page is a placeholder.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: We store your Google name, email address and profile picture so your team can recognise you, plus the matches you play. Nothing else. This page is a placeholder.

link.title: Find your member ID
link.memberIdHelp: The number on your league card.

list.subtitle: Every team in the league. Open a team to manage its divisions, roster and captain.
list.selectAll: Select all teams on this page
list.emptyBody: Create a team in its home division to start building rosters and fixtures.
list.noMatchesBody: Try another search, or clear the filters.
list.errorBody: The server didn't respond. Check your connection, then try again.

filters.search: Search teams by name or code
filters.invalidId: Paste the full ID. It looks like 7b1f0a52-2c6e-4d0a-9a3e-1f0c2b9d4e11.

bulk.confirmBody: They disappear from the league and their players become free to join another team. Fixtures and results stay.
bulk.resultPlayersFreed: Their players are free to join another team.

create.title: New team
create.description: The team is entered into its home division. You can add more divisions later.
create.captainLater: You'll pick a captain after you add players. The captain must be on the team's active roster.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.impactHidden: hides it everywhere in the league
delete.impactPlayers: frees its players so they can join another team
delete.impactFixtures: keeps its fixtures and their results
delete.permanentHint: Only possible for a team with no fixtures. This can't be undone.
delete.permanentFailed: {{name}} was deleted, but couldn't be deleted permanently: {{reason}}

form.divisionIdHint: Rosters and fixtures belong to the team's entry in this division.
form.venueIdHint: The venue's identifier is the middle of the team code.
form.venueIdEditHint: Paste another venue's ID to move the team. A venue can't be removed here.
form.teamCodeHint: Region, venue, team number (XXyyA). Unique within the division.
form.name: Team name
form.captainHint: Only players on the active roster shown below can be captain.
form.captainNoRoster: Choose a division with players below to pick a captain.

errors.teamCode: Use 5 characters in the format XXyyA, for example 41504.
errors.duplicateCode: This code is already used in this division.
errors.id: Paste the full ID, or leave it empty.
errors.targetTeam: Choose the team to move to.

codeRules.title: How team codes work
codeRules.regionBody: Region (XX). 2-digit postcode of the venue's district. Saigon uses 41 or 50–59.
codeRules.venueBody: Venue (yy). 2-digit identifier of the host venue.
codeRules.teamBody: Team (A). The team's number at that venue, 0 to 9.
codeRules.capacityBody: A venue identifier holds at most 10 teams. When it's full, the venue gets an extra identifier for new teams. The code must be unique in its division.

conflict.create: A team with this code already exists in this division.
conflict.update: Another team in this division already uses this code.
conflict.deletePermanently: The team has scheduled or played matches, so it can't be deleted permanently.
conflict.addDivision: The team has already entered this division.
conflict.removeDivision: The team has matches in this division, so it can't leave it.
conflict.addPlayer: This player is already on a team in this division.
conflict.transfer: This player can't be moved: they are the captain, or already on a team in that division.
conflict.removePlayer: This player is the captain. Pick a new captain first.

detail.title: Team details
detail.captainDetail: Must be on the active roster
detail.createdDetail: A team keeps one code for life
detail.notFoundBody: This team was deleted, or the link is wrong. Deleted teams don't appear anywhere in the league.

roster.title: Roster by division
roster.chooseDivisionBody: Each division has its own roster. Paste a division ID above to see it.
roster.notEnteredTitle: The team isn't in this division
roster.notEnteredBody: Add the team to the division to build its roster there.
roster.emptyTitle: No players in this division yet
roster.emptyBody: Each division has its own roster. Add players here, then choose a captain from them.
roster.showing: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} players · Sorted by join date
roster.captainNote: The captain can't be removed or transferred. Pick a new captain first.

addPlayer.title: Add player
addPlayer.playerIdHint: A player can be on only one team per division.

transfer.title: Transfer player
transfer.targetTeamPlaceholder: Choose a team in this division
transfer.divisionHint: Leave empty to keep the player's current division.
transfer.impactStats: their matches and points stay with {{team}}
transfer.impactFresh: they start fresh on the new team

removePlayer.title: Remove {{name}}?
removePlayer.description: They leave {{team}}'s roster in this division. Their matches stay in the history.

addDivision.title: Add to a division
addDivision.description: Enter {{team}} in another division or session.
addDivision.note: The new entry starts with an empty roster and no fixtures. A player can be on only one active team per division.

removeDivision.title: Remove {{team}} from this division?
removeDivision.description: Its roster in this division closes. Only possible while the team has no matches there.
